decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the premises shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 4 - The proposed roller shutters hereby permitted, shall be of a 'Aluminium Punched' type that provides transparency to the shopfront, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - It is considered that this application for the installation of a shop front at units 5+6 Brentford Lock would by reason of its scale and proportions relate to the of the existing building and will be in keeping with the character and appearance of the area.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), S.4.2 (Shop Fronts) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.

Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE

The use of the premises as one store is in conflict with condition 4 of the original consent for the premises (Ref 00607/AS/P4) , which  states that "There shall be no amalgamation of any of the approved A1 or A3 units without the prior consent of the LPA"
description: Installation of new shop front to existing site
